text: EX-10.1 2 exhibit101-formofcashltipr.htm EX-10.1 Document Exhibit 10.1 [Company Logo] November [__], 2026 [Employee Name___] Dear [Employee]: Beyond Meat (the “ Company ”) values your future contributions and desires to provide a retention cash incentive award in the aggregate amount of $______ (the “ Award ”) to you on the terms set forth in this letter agreement (the “ Letter Agreement ”), pursuant to which the Award is being granted. 1. Cash Incentive Award . (a) You will be eligible to receive a payment in the amount of $____ (the “ First Payment ”) on DATE, 2027 (the “ First Vesting Date ”), subject to your continued employment with the Company or a subsidiary through the First Vesting Date. (b) You will be eligible to receive a payment in the amount of $____ (the “ Second Payment ”) on DATE, 2028 (the “ Second Vesting Date ”), subject to your continued employment with the Company or a subsidiary through the Second Vesting Date. (c) You will be eligible to receive a payment in the amount of $____ (the “ Third Payment ”) on DATE, 2029 (the “ Third Vesting Date ”), subject to your continued employment with the Company or a subsidiary through the Third Vesting Date. (d) You will be eligible to receive a payment in the amount of $____ (the “ Fourth Payment ,” and together with the First Payment, the Second Payment and the Third Payment, the “ Payments ”) on DATE, 2030 (the “ Fourth Vesting Date ,” and together with the First Vesting Date, the Second Vesting Date and the Third Vesting Date, the “ Vesting Dates ”), subject to your continued employment with the Company or a subsidiary through the Fourth Vesting Date. Each Payment will be paid to you in cash on the first payroll date following the applicable Vesting Date specified above. 2. Effect of Termination of Employment; At-Will Employment . Your eligibility for receipt of each Payment is contingent upon your continued active employment with the Company or a subsidiary through the applicable Vesting Date. If your employment terminates for any reason prior to the Vesting Date for a Payment, then you will forfeit any right you may have to receive the Payment scheduled to vest on such Vesting Date and any future remaining unpaid Payment(s) under this Letter Agreement. This Letter Agreement does not affect your employment relationship with the Company or its subsidiaries; that is, employment with the Company and its subsidiaries remains at-will unless otherwise expressly agreed in a separate written contract between you and the Company or any subsidiary. The Company or your employer shall have the discretion to determine when a termination of employment has occurred for purposes of this Letter Agreement and to what extent the continued vesting in the Payments shall be suspended or extended (or the Payments reduced) during any leave of absence or as a result of any reduction in time commitment; provided, however, that in the absence of such determination, (a) you will continue to vest in your Payments for purposes of this Letter Agreement during any paid leave, (b) the vesting of your Payments shall be suspended during any unpaid leave on terms established by the Company or your employer at the time of your request for such unpaid leave (unless otherwise required by applicable law) with the effect of extending the overall vesting period by the period of such unpaid leave (but if the extension would cause a Payment to be payable later than March 15 of the calendar year following the original Vesting Date of such Payment, the Payment will be forfeited unless applicable law requires otherwise), and (c) your remaining unpaid Payments will be proportionately reduced to reflect any reduction in time commitment (e.g., change in status from full-time to part-time). 3. Tax and Other Deductions . The Payments will be paid, less foreign, federal, state and local taxes required to be withheld by the Company or your employer, plus any solidarity surcharge, and any other employment related taxes or social contributions required by law or Company policy in any jurisdiction. 4. Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code . This Letter Agreement is intended to be interpreted and applied so that the Award will be exempt from the requirements of Section 409A of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended (the “ Code ”). To the extent applicable, this Letter Agreement shall be interpreted consistent with such intention or, if such an exemption is not satisfied, then in accordance with Section 409A of the Code and Department of Treasury regulations and other interpretive guidance issued thereunder. For purposes of Section 409A of the Code, each installment payment provided under this Letter Agreement shall be treated as a separate payment. If any portion of the Award constitutes “nonqualified deferred compensation” within the meaning of Section 409A of the Code, any payments to be made under this Letter Agreement upon a termination of employment shall only be made upon a “separation from service” under Section 409A of the Code. 5. Confidentiality . The information provided in this Letter Agreement is personal. Other than as permitted or required by applicable law, the Company intends to treat it with the same degree of confidentiality with which we treat other compensation information and asks that you treat it in the same manner. 6. Language . You acknowledge that you are proficient in the English language and understand the provisions in this Letter Agreement or have had the ability to consult with an advisor who is sufficiently proficient in the English language, as to allow you to understand the terms of this Letter Agreement. Further, if you have received this Letter Agreement or any other document related to this Letter Agreement translated into a language other than English and if the meaning of the translated version is different than the English version, the English version will control. 7. Applicable Currency . Your Payments are denominated in US Dollars but may be paid in any other currency based on the prevailing exchange rate as the Company or your employer deems appropriate. 8. Independent of Other Compensation . The Payments described herein are independent of all other compensation you may be eligible to receive from the Company or any 2 subsidiary. Your Payments are being awarded on a discretionary basis and will not form part of your contractual remuneration under your employment contract, if applicable. Your receipt of this Letter Agreement does not impose any obligation on the Company or any subsidiary to make any subsequent awards. 9. Miscellaneous . This Letter Agreement may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same agreement. This Letter Agreement will not give any rights or remedies to any person other than the undersigned employee and the Company and its successors. This Letter Agreement will be governed by the laws of the state or country in which you are employed as of the date hereof, excluding any conflict of laws principles that mandate the use of another jurisdiction’s laws. This Letter Agreement sets forth the entire understanding of you and the Company with respect to the subject matter hereof and shall supersede any agreement, arrangement or policy to which the Company is a party with respect to the Payments. This Letter Agreement may not be amended or modified except by a written instrument signed by you and an authorized officer of the Company. You shall have no rights under this Letter Agreement other than as an unsecured general creditor of the Company and its subsidiaries. The arrangement outlined in this Letter Agreement reflects the importance of your contributions and our desire to retain you as a key member of our team. Thank you for your dedication. We are confident that we can look to you to continue the important work that you are doing for the organization. Sincerely, Ethan Brown Chief Executive Officer I acknowledge that I understand and agree to abide by the provisions set forth in the above stated Letter Agreement. Print Name: 3

title: Z Squared Inc.
text: EX-10.1 2 zsqrex10-1.htm EXHIBIT 10.1 Exhibit 10.1 Assignment, Assumption and Amendment of Land Option Agreement Parties This Assignment, Assumption and Amendment of Land Option Agreement (this “ Agreement ”) is entered into as of November 11, 2026 (the “ Assignment Date ”) by and among: LERRO ENERGY GROUP L.L.C., a Texas limited liability company (“ Seller ”); PARADOX INFRASTRUCTURE LLC, a Florida limited liability company (“ Assignor ”); and PARADOX DATA, LLC, a Florida limited liability company (“ Assignee ”). Recitals A. Seller owns approximately 92.56 acres, as shown on the survey described in Section 5.1, in Union County, Arkansas, commonly known as 713 Industrial Road, El Dorado, Arkansas 71730, PIN 00000-16916-0100, Deed Reference 2014-004130 (the “ Parent Parcel ”). B. Under the Agreement to Purchase and Sell Real Property effective October 31, 2023 (the “ 2023 Purchase Agreement ”), Assignor purchased approximately 3.00 acres of the Parent Parcel; that purchase has closed and the purchase price has been paid in full. C. In connection with the 2023 Purchase Agreement, and as set forth in its Exhibit B-1 (together, as they relate to the option, the “ Option Agreement ”), Seller granted Assignor the exclusive right to purchase the remaining approximately 89.56 acres of the Parent Parcel, as shown on the survey described in Section 5.1 (the “ Option Property ”). The Option Agreement is governed by the 2023 Purchase Agreement, remains in effect, and has no stated expiration. D. Seller and Assignee entered into a Binding Letter of Intent – Land Purchase effective June 23, 2026 (the “ LOI ”) for the purchase of a tract of up to 10 acres within the Option Property (the “ Initial Tract ”). E. The parties intend that Assignee will acquire the Initial Tract as the first takedown under the option, after completing its pre-exercise investigations under Section 2.7, under a purchase agreement substantially in the form attached as Exhibit B (the “ Form Purchase Agreement ”), at Twenty Thousand Dollars ($20,000.00) per surveyed acre, as contemplated by the LOI, subject to the conditions stated in that purchase agreement. The parties have agreed to amend the option terms as set forth in this Agreement. F. Assignor desires to assign the Option Agreement to Assignee, Assignee desires to assume it, and Seller consents to the assignment and agrees to amend the Option Agreement as set forth below, in consideration of the Consent Payment under Section 1.5. 1. Assignment and Assumption 1.1 Assignment. Effective on the Assignment Date, and for the mutual agreements in this Agreement, Assignor assigns to Assignee all of Assignor’s right, title, and interest in and to the Option Agreement and the Option Property. No payment is due to Assignor or Seller for the assignment itself, other than the Consent Payment under Section 1.5 and the Option Fees under Section 2.2. 1.2 Assumption. Assignee accepts the assignment and assumes all obligations of the optionee under the Option Agreement, as amended by this Agreement, arising on or after the Assignment Date. 1.3 Seller Consent. Seller consents to this assignment for purposes of Section 13 of the 2023 Purchase Agreement, which governs the Option Agreement. Seller’s consent to this assignment, and Seller’s agreement to the amended option terms in Section 2 (including the five-year Option Term under Section 2.1), are each conditioned on Seller’s receipt of the Consent Payment under Section 1.5. 1.4 Assignor Release. Assignor retains no right to purchase any portion of the Option Property. Assignor remains responsible for any obligation under the Option Agreement accrued before the Assignment Date. 1.5 Consent Payment. In consideration of Seller’s consent to the assignment under Section 1.3 and Seller’s agreement to the amended option terms in Section 2, including the five-year Option Term under Section 2.1, Assignee shall pay Seller a one-time payment of Thirty-Seven Thousand Five Hundred Dollars ($37,500.00) (the “ Consent Payment ”) at execution of this Agreement, by wire transfer or other immediately available funds. The Consent Payment is in addition to the Option Fees under Section 2.2 and the LOI Deposit under Section 3.3, is non-refundable once paid, and is not credited against any Option Fee or purchase price. This Agreement, including Seller’s consent and the amendments in Sections 2 and 4, is not effective until Seller receives the Consent Payment and the first Option Fee. 2. Amended Option Terms 2.1 Option Term. The option, which previously had no fixed term, runs for five (5) years from the Assignment Date and expires at 11:59 p.m. Central Time on the day before the fifth anniversary of the Assignment Date (the “ Option Term ”). Any Option Property not under contract by then is released from the option. 2.2 Option Fee. Assignee shall pay Seller Ten Thousand Dollars ($10,000.00) for each year of the Option Term (each, an “ Option Fee ”): (a) The first Option Fee is due on the Assignment Date. This Agreement is not effective until Seller receives it and the Consent Payment under Section 1.5. (b) Each later Option Fee is due on or before each anniversary of the Assignment Date (years 2–5; maximum total $50,000.00). 2 (c) No further Option Fee is due once Assignee has purchased all of the Option Property. (d) Option Fees are non-refundable and are not credited against any purchase price. 2.3 Failure to Pay. If an Option Fee is not paid within thirty (30) days after Assignee’s receipt of Seller’s written notice of non-payment, delivered to Assignee and its counsel in accordance with Section 7.3, including the required email copies, the option terminates and Seller retains all Option Fees paid. Termination does not affect any tract already under contract or conveyed. 2.4 Exercise. Assignee may exercise the option in one or more takedowns by written notice to Seller identifying the proposed tract (an “ Exercise Notice ”). Each tract shall be a single contiguous tract with legal access. 2.5 Closing. Each takedown shall be made under a purchase agreement substantially in the form of the Form Purchase Agreement attached as Exhibit B, with the tract’s survey and legal description attached as its Schedule 1 and with conforming changes for the tract, purchase price, and dates, which Seller shall sign within thirty (30) days after Assignee delivers it (each, a “ Takedown Purchase Agreement ”). The purchase price under each Takedown Purchase Agreement is set by Section 3 and paid in cash at closing (with no promissory note, deed of trust, or vendor’s lien). Each takedown closes on or before the Outside Date stated in the Takedown Purchase Agreement. Acreage is determined by survey. Each Exercise Notice shall attach a survey and legal description of the tract prepared by an Arkansas-licensed surveyor. That survey and legal description conclusively identify the tract under contract, and Seller’s signature on this Agreement authorizes Assignee to designate the tract in this manner, whether or not Seller signs the Takedown Purchase Agreement. Seller conveys by special warranty deed, warranting title only against claims arising by, through, or under Seller, and not otherwise. Seller shall pay off and release at or before each closing any mortgage, deed of trust, judgment lien, or other lien securing the payment of money that encumbers the tract and was created by, through, or under Seller. Seller has no obligation to pay off, release, or cure any other lien, encumbrance, or title matter, including any monetary lien not created by, through, or under Seller. Seller may decline to cure any title objection Assignee timely makes under the Takedown Purchase Agreement by written notice to Assignee, in which case Assignee’s sole remedy is to waive the objection or terminate that takedown. Closing costs are allocated as in Section 6.4 of the Form Purchase Agreement. Each tract is sold “AS IS, WHERE IS, WITH ALL FAULTS,” with all defects and conditions, known or unknown, and without any representation or warranty of any kind, express or implied, including as to title, except the special warranty in the deed and as provided in the Takedown Purchase Agreement. This Section 2.5 survives each closing. 2.6 Access and Utility Easements. At each takedown closing, Seller shall grant to Assignee, without additional consideration, perpetual, non-exclusive easements over the portion of the Parent Parcel retained by Seller for (a) ingress and egress to a public road and (b) the installation, operation, maintenance, and replacement of utilities serving the tract, including electric power, fiber-optic and other telecommunications lines, water, sewer, and gas. The easements shall be located as reasonably designated by Assignee and approved by Seller, which approval shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. Seller shall not terminate, relocate, or interfere with any existing easement, access route, or utility line serving the approximately 3.00-acre tract conveyed under the 2023 Purchase Agreement. Each deed shall reserve to Seller, for the benefit of the portion of the Parent Parcel retained by Seller, a perpetual, non-exclusive easement for ingress and egress and for the installation, operation, maintenance, and replacement of utilities serving that retained portion, over and within a corridor not exceeding thirty (30) feet in width, located as shown on Exhibit C, to the extent that corridor lies within the tract conveyed. 3 2.7 Pre-Exercise Access. During the Option Term and before delivering any Exercise Notice, Assignee and its consultants, engineers, and surveyors may enter the Option Property at reasonable times, on at least two (2) days’ prior notice to Seller (which may be given by email), to conduct surveys, staking, boundary and topographic work, Phase I environmental site assessments, geotechnical, utility, and engineering review, site planning, and other non-invasive investigations Assignee considers appropriate to select each tract and prepare its legal description. Assignee shall not conduct any invasive testing, including soil borings or groundwater sampling, without Seller’s prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed. Assignee’s investigations are at its sole cost, and Assignee shall not unreasonably interfere with Seller’s use of the Parent Parcel. The payment of the Operational Collection Floor Increase in the amount of $25,000 is made at the sole discretion of the Administrative Agent and Lender under the condition that as of the Credit Date, after giving effect to this payment requested on the Credit Date, no event would result from the consummation of the borrowing contemplated hereby that would constitute an Event of Default or a Default. The Borrower shall not derive any claims for additional payments or any further rights from this payment. Additional payments under the Operational Collection Floor Increase may only be made at the sole discretion of the Administrative Agent and Lender. Except as set forth above, the Administrative Agent reserves all of its rights under the Credit Agreement. In addition, the Administrative Agent provided funding in the amount of $550,000 on April 10, 2025 to MSP Recovery, LLC, for payment of legal expenses (together with the Aggregate Operational Collection Floor: “ Additional Financing ”). The Administrative Agent confirms that as of the date of this letter, other than as set forth above, the conditions to funding of the Operational Collection Floor Increase by the Lender have either been satisfied or waived by it; provided however, that the Administrative Agent reserves all of its rights under the Credit Agreement and each of the related agreements in respect thereof should an event occur or new information become available to the Administrative Agent immediately prior to funding. The Administrative Agent and Lender is aware that Owner Pledgor is in receipt of HC Case Proceeds of approximately $1,300,000 1 related to property and casualty litigation (the “HC Case Proceeds”), which (x) 50% of such proceeds are due to Assignor, and (y) 50% of such proceeds are due to the Assignee. The Collections from the HC Case Proceeds (in the total approximate amount of $605,313 2 ) have been granted as Collateral to the Lender, pursuant to the Credit Agreement . The payment of the Operational Collection Floor Increase in the amount of $30,825 is made at the sole discretion of the Administrative Agent and Lender under the condition that as of the Credit Date, after giving effect to this payment requested on the Credit Date, no event would result from the consummation of the borrowing contemplated hereby that would constitute an Event of Default or a Default. The Borrower shall not derive any claims for additional payments or any further rights from this payment. Additional payments under the Operational Collection Floor Increase may only be made at the sole discretion of the Administrative Agent and Lender. Except as set forth above, the Administrative Agent reserves all of its rights under the Credit Agreement. text: EX-10.1 2 tm2629979d1_ex10-1.htm EXHIBIT 10.1 Exhibit 10.1 EXECUTION VERSION PORTIONS OF THIS EXHIBIT HAVE BEEN REDACTED PURSUANT TO ITEM 601(b)(10)(iv) OF REGULATION SK. EXCHANGE RIGHT AGREEMENT This Exchange Right Agreement (this “ Agreement ”) is entered into as of November 12, 2026 (the “ Effective Date ”), by and among Mobile X Global, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the “ Company ”), CONX Corp., a Nevada corporation (“ CONX ”), and each Person identified on Schedule A attached hereto (the “ Stockholders ”). Each of the Company, CONX and the Stockholders are sometimes referred to herein individually as a “ Party ” and collectively as the “ Parties ”. RECITALS WHEREAS, on July 31, 2026, the Company, CONX and CONX Wireless, LLC, a Colorado limited liability company and indirect subsidiary of CONX (“ CONX Wireless ”), entered into that certain agreement and plan of merger (the “ Merger Agreement ”), pursuant to which CONX Wireless merged with and into the Company, with the Company continuing as the surviving corporation (the “ Merger ”); WHEREAS, substantially concurrently with the execution and delivery of this Agreement and the consummation of the Merger, the Company, CONX Wireless Holdings, LLC, a Colorado limited liability company and wholly owned subsidiary of CONX, and the Stockholders have entered into that certain Amended and Restated Stockholders Agreement of the Company, dated as of the date hereof (the “ Stockholders Agreement ”), providing for the certain rights and obligations of the parties thereto; WHEREAS, capitalized terms used but not defined herein shall have the meanings ascribed to such terms in the Stockholders Agreement; and WHEREAS, in connection with the consummation of the Merger and the entry into the Stockholders Agreement, each of the Company and CONX desire to grant to the Stockholders the right, subject to the terms and conditions set forth in this Agreement, to exchange Company Shares for a number of shares of Class A common stock of CONX, par value $0.0001 (the “ CONX Shares ”) equal to (a) the Exchange Ratio (as defined herein) multiplied by (b) the number of shares of common stock of the Company, $0.0001 par value per share (“ Company Shares ”), to be exchanged. AGREEMENT NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and of the representations, warranties, covenants and agreements set forth in this Agreement, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties, intending to be legally bound, hereby agree as follows: 1. Exchange Right . a. Right to Exchange . Subject to the terms and conditions of this Agreement (including, for the avoidance of doubt, the satisfaction of each of the Minimum Stockholder Condition, the Accredited Investor Condition and the Regulatory Condition), each Stockholder shall have the right to exchange up to 100% of such holder’s Company Shares for CONX Shares (the “ Exchange Right ”) commencing on (i) for each Stockholder of the Company that is also an employee of the Company but is not (A) a Stockholder set forth on Schedule B attached hereto (each such Stockholder set forth on Schedule B attached hereto, a “ Management Stockholder ”) or (B) a Permitted Transferee of any such Management Stockholder, the first anniversary of the Effective Date or (ii) for each other Stockholder, the second anniversary of the Effective Date. To exercise the Exchange Right, the exercising Stockholder, or Stockholders, as the case may be, shall provide written notice to the Company indicating such Stockholder’s exercise of the Exchange Right and the number of Company Shares to be subject to such exercise (each such notice, an “ Exchange Request ” and the date the Company receives an Exchange Request, the “ Exchange Request Date ”). A Stockholder may not deliver an Exchange Request more than one time during any given six-month period, and any such Exchange Request delivered in violation of the foregoing shall be void for all purposes. 2. Exchange Ratio . The “ Exchange Ratio ” shall be equal to the ratio, rounded to the fourth decimal place, of (a) the Share Valuation, divided by (b) (i)if CONX Shares (A) are not listed on or (B) have not then traded for at least 20 consecutive trading days, in each case, on any national securities exchange as of the Exchange Request Date, the CONX Appraised Valuation or (ii) if CONX Shares are listed on and have traded for 20 or more consecutive trading days on a national securities exchange as of the Exchange Request Date, the CONX VWAP Price. The “ CONX VWAP Price ” means the volume-weighted average price of CONX Shares for the 20 consecutive trading day period ending on the trading day immediately preceding the date of the Appraiser Report, appropriately adjusted for any stock split, stock dividend, combination, recapitalization or similar event occurring during such period. 3. Conditions . a. The consummation of any Exchange Right shall be contingent upon a Stockholder, or a group of Stockholders, submitting an Exchange Request that collectively seeks to exchange at least 7.5% of the Company Shares on a fully-diluted and as-converted basis (the “ Minimum Stockholder Condition ”). An Exchange Request may not be combined with any other Exchange Request for the purposes of satisfying the Minimum Stockholder Condition unless such Exchange Request specifically references the other Exchange Requests. If the Minimum Stockholder Condition is not satisfied in respect of any Exchange Request (or group of combinable Exchange Requests pursuant to this Section 3.a) ), then such Exchange Request shall be deemed withdrawn and void for all purposes. b. The consummation of any Exchange Right shall be contingent upon the applicable Stockholder being an “accredited investor” within the meaning of Regulation D promulgated under the Securities Act (the “ Accredited Investor Condition ”). Prior to, and as a condition to the consummation of any Exchange Right, each Stockholder seeking to exchange Company Shares pursuant to an Exchange Request shall provide CONX with written evidence as to the ability of such Stockholder to satisfy the Accredited Investor Condition, which evidence shall be in form and substance reasonably acceptable to CONX. If the Accredited Investor Condition is not satisfied in respect of any Exchange Request, then such Exchange Request shall be deemed withdrawn and void for all purposes. c. The consummation of any Exchange Right shall be contingent upon (i) the absence of any order of a Governmental Authority of competent jurisdiction or Applicable Law, in each case, preventing or making illegal the consummation of the Exchange Right, (ii) the expiration or termination of any applicable waiting periods for the consummation of the Exchange Right, and (iii) the proper delivery of any notices and the receipt of all approvals or consents required to be obtained from any Governmental Authority under applicable law in connection with the consummation of the Exchange Right (clauses (i) through (iii) collectively, the “ Regulatory Condition ”). If the Regulatory Condition is not satisfied in respect of any Exchange Request within 180 days of the delivery of any Exchange Request, then such Exchange Request shall be deemed withdrawn and void for all purposes. 2 4. Exchange Valuation Procedures . Within 15 days after an Exchange Request Date (each, an “ Appraiser Engagement Period ”), the Company shall, in its reasonable discretion, engage a third-party appraiser of national recognition (the “ Company Appraiser ”) to determine the per share value of the Company Shares (the “ Share Valuation ”) and, if applicable, the CONX Shares (the “ CONX Appraised Valuation ”). The Company Appraiser shall issue a report setting forth the Share Valuation and, if applicable, the CONX Appraised Valuation (the “ Appraiser Report ”), and the Share Valuation and, if applicable, the CONX Appraised Valuation set forth therein shall be conclusive and binding upon the Company, CONX and the Stockholders absent fraud or manifest error. A copy of the Appraiser Report shall be made available to each Stockholder submitting the applicable Exchange Request. The reasonable and documented fees and expenses of the Company Appraiser shall be borne by the Company. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary set forth in this Agreement, if an Appraiser Report has been issued in the 12-month period preceding an Exchange Request (any such report, a “ Prior Appraiser Report ”), then the Company, in its sole discretion, may rely on such Prior Appraiser Report for purposes of determining the Share Valuation and, if applicable, the CONX Appraised Valuation and in such a circumstance the Share Valuation and, if applicable, the CONX Appraised Valuation shall be conclusive and binding upon the Company, CONX and the Stockholders absent fraud or manifest error (which error may not be based on the passage of time or the occurrence of any event since the delivery of the Prior Appraiser Report). For the avoidance of doubt, in no event shall the Company be required to obtain more than one Appraiser Report in any 12-month period. 5. Mechanics of Exchange . As a condition to the exercise of an Exchange Right, each Stockholder who participated in the applicable Exchange Request, must deliver written notice to the Company of their decision to exercise the Exchange Right within five business days of the delivery of notice of a copy of the Appraiser Report to such Stockholder (the “ Exchange Election ”). Within 15 business days following the Exchange Election, such Stockholder shall surrender to the Company any certificates underlying the Company Shares to be exchanged and deliver such other documentation to the Company or CONX, as applicable, in connection with the cancellation of the applicable Company Shares and the issuance of the applicable CONX Shares, in each case reasonably requested by either of the Company or CONX. As soon as practicable thereafter, CONX shall issue such Stockholder the number of CONX Shares to which such Stockholder is entitled pursuant to the Exchange Right. 6. No Fractional Shares . No fractional shares shall be issued upon the exchange of any Company Shares, and the aggregate number of CONX Shares to be issued to any Stockholder, shall be rounded down to the nearest whole share. 7. Representations and Warranties . a. Each Stockholder hereby represents and warrants that: i. such Stockholder has the corporate or other requisite power and authority to execute and deliver this Agreement, to perform its obligations hereunder and to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby; 3 ii. this Agreement constitutes the legal, valid, and binding obligation of such Stockholder, enforceable against such Stockholder in accordance with its terms except as enforceability may be limited by applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, or similar laws affecting the enforcement of creditors’ rights generally and by general equitable principles (whether enforcement is sought by proceedings in equity or at law), and the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby require no action by, or in respect of, or filing with, any Governmental Authority, subject only to the Regulatory Condition in connection with the consummation of any Exchange Right; iii. the execution, delivery, and performance by such Stockholder of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby do not: (A) conflict with or result in any violation or breach of any provision of any of the governing documents of such Stockholder; (B) conflict with or result in any violation or breach of any provision of any Applicable Law; or (C) require any consent or other action by any Person under any provision of any material agreement or other instrument to which the Stockholder is a party; iv. such Stockholder is an “accredited investor” within the meaning of Regulation D under the Securities Act and such Stockholder acknowledges that the issuance of the Exchange Right has not been registered under the Securities Act or any state securities laws and is being made in reliance upon an exemption from the registration requirements thereof; v. such Stockholder acknowledges that the CONX Shares to be issued in connection with the Exchange Right (A) will not be registered under the Securities Act or any state securities laws and will only be issued pursuant to an exemption from registration thereunder, (B) will be “restricted securities” as such term is defined under the Securities Act and (C) may be transferred only pursuant to an exemption from registration under the Securities Act; vi. such Stockholder acknowledges that neither the Company, CONX nor any person acting on their behalf offered the Exchange Right (or the CONX Shares, as applicable) through any form of general solicitation or general advertising; and vii. such Stockholder acknowledges that neither CONX nor any class of securities of CONX is currently, or may ever be, listed for trading on any national securities exchange and that the absence of a liquid trading market could have a material impact on the value of the CONX Shares to be issued in connection with the Exchange Right. b. The Company hereby represents and warrants that: i. it has the corporate or other requisite power and authority to execute and deliver this Agreement, to perform its obligations hereunder and to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby; and ii. this Agreement constitutes the legal, valid, and binding obligation of the Company, enforceable against the Company in accordance with its terms except as enforceability may be limited by applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, or similar laws affecting the enforcement of creditors’ rights generally and by general equitable principles (whether enforcement is sought by proceedings in equity or at law) and the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement require no action by, or in respect of, or filing with, any Governmental Authority, subject only to the Regulatory Condition in connection with the consummation of any Exchange Right. 4 c. CONX hereby represents and warrants that: i. CONX has the corporate or other requisite power and authority to execute and deliver this Agreement, to perform its obligations hereunder and to consummate the transactions contemplated hereby; and ii. this Agreement constitutes the legal, valid, and binding obligation of CONX, enforceable against CONX in accordance with its terms except as enforceability may be limited by applicable bankruptcy, insolvency, reorganization, moratorium, or similar laws affecting the enforcement of creditors’ rights generally and by general equitable principles (whether enforcement is sought by proceedings in equity or at law) and the execution, delivery, and performance of this Agreement require no action by, or in respect of, or filing with, any Governmental Authority, subject only to the Regulatory Condition in connection with the consummation of any Exchange Right. 8. Covenants . Following the Effective Date, CONX shall use commercially reasonable efforts to (a) become current in its filing obligations under the Securities and Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, and (b) cause the CONX Shares to become listed for trading on a national securities exchange. Notwithstanding anything to the contrary set forth in this Agreement (including this Section 8 ), nothing in this Agreement shall (i) require CONX to take any action that CONX, in its sole discretion, determines may be adverse to CONX and its stockholders or (ii) prohibit, restrict or otherwise impair CONX or any of its Affiliates from proposing, negotiating, entering into, consummating or effecting any merger, consolidation, recapitalization, reorganization, business combination, change of control transaction, financing or other similar transaction involving CONX or any of its Subsidiaries (each, a “ Corporate Transaction ”), whether or not any such Corporate Transaction adversely affects the Exchange Right or the rights or interests of any Stockholder hereunder. Each Stockholder, on behalf of itself, its Affiliates and their respective Representatives, and their respective successors and assigns, hereby unconditionally and irrevocably waives, releases and agrees not to assert any claim, cause of action or other proceeding against CONX, any of its Affiliates or any of their respective Representatives arising out of or relating to any actual or alleged diminution, impairment, modification, cancellation or termination of the Exchange Right resulting from the negotiation, execution or consummation of a Corporate Transaction. 9. Further Assurances . Each of the Parties agrees to do, execute, acknowledge, and deliver (and to cause to be done, executed, acknowledged and delivered) all such further acts, documents, conveyances and assurances as may be reasonably requested by the other Parties, or any successor or permitted assign thereof, in order to carry out the transactions contemplated in this Agreement. 10. Successors and Assigns; Assignment . Subject to the rights and restrictions on Transfers set forth in this Agreement, this Agreement is binding upon and shall inure to the benefit of the Parties and their respective heirs, executors, administrators, legal representatives, successors, and permitted assigns; provided, that each Stockholder hereby acknowledges that the Exchange Right is personal to such Stockholder and, except Transfers to a Stockholders’ Permitted Transferee, no Stockholder may, directly or indirectly, assign, Transfer, or delegate any or all of its rights or obligations under this Agreement, voluntarily or involuntarily, including by Change of Control, merger (whether or not such Stockholder is the surviving entity), operation of law, or otherwise, without the prior written consent of each of the Company and CONX, and any such assignment, transfer, or delegation in violation of this Agreement shall be null and void ab initio . 5 11. Amendments . This Agreement may not be amended, supplemented or changed, and no provision hereof may be waived, except in accordance with Section 9.11 of the Stockholders Agreement. 12. Governing Law . This Agreement shall be construed and enforced in accordance with, and all questions concerning the construction, validity, interpretation and performance of this Agreement shall be governed by, the internal laws of the State of Nevada, without giving effect to provisions thereof regarding conflict of laws. 13. Counterparts . This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Counterparts may be delivered via facsimile, electronic mail (including pdf or any electronic signature complying with the U.S. federal ESIGN Act of 2000, e.g., www.docusign.com) or other transmission method and any counterpart so delivered shall be deemed to have been duly and validly delivered and be valid and effective for all purposes. 14. Headings . The headings of this Agreement are used for convenience and are not to be considered in construing or interpreting this Agreement. 15. Severability . The invalidity or unenforceability of any provision hereof shall in no way affect the validity or enforceability of any other provision. 16. Entire Agreement . This Agreement, the Merger Agreement and the Stockholders Agreement constitute the sole and entire agreement of the parties with respect to the subject matter contained herein and therein, and supersede all prior and contemporaneous understandings and agreements, both written and oral, with respect to such subject matter. 17. Submission to Jurisdiction . The Parties hereby agree that any claim, action or lawsuit arising out of or relating to this Agreement or any of the transactions contemplated hereby may be initiated in the United States District Court for the District of Nevada, Las Vegas Division, or, if such court lacks subject matter jurisdiction, the state courts of the State of Nevada located in Clark County, Nevada (the “ Chosen Courts ”), and the Parties further agree that venue for all such matters shall lie exclusively in the Chosen Courts. The Parties hereby irrevocably waive, to the fullest extent permitted by Applicable Law, any objection which they may now or hereafter have, including any claim of forum non conveniens , to venue in the Chosen Courts. The Parties agree that a judgment in any such dispute may be enforced in other jurisdictions by suit on the judgment or in any other manner provided by law. 18. Waiver of Jury Trial . EACH PARTY IRREVOCABLY AND UNCONDITIONALLY WAIVES, TO THE FULLEST EXTENT PERMITTED BY APPLICABLE LAW, ANY RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO A TRIAL BY JURY IN ANY LEGAL ACTION, PROCEEDING, CAUSE OF ACTION, OR COUNTERCLAIM ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING ANY EXHIBITS AND SCHEDULES ATTACHED TO THIS AGREEMENT, OR THE TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY . 19. Equitable Remedies . Each Party acknowledges that a breach or threatened breach by such Party of any of its obligations under this Agreement would give rise to irreparable harm to the other Parties for which monetary damages would not be an adequate remedy, and each Party hereby agrees that in the event of a breach or a threatened breach by such Party of any such obligations, each of the other Parties shall, in addition to any and all other rights and remedies that may be available to them in respect of such breach, be entitled to equitable relief, including specific performance, and any other relief that may be available from a court of competent jurisdiction (without any requirement to post bond or other security or prove actual damages or that monetary damages will not afford an adequate remedy). 6 20. No Waiver; Remedies Cumulative . No waiver hereunder shall be effective unless signed by the waiving Party in writing, and then is only effective for the specific instance and purpose for which it is given, notwithstanding, to the maximum extent permitted by Applicable Law, any course of dealing, custom or practice, and/or course of performance. text: EX-10.1 4 ea031248601ex10-1.htm EXCHANGE AGREEMENT, DATED NOVEMBER 12, 2026, BY AND BETWEEN ALLARITY THERAPEUTICS, INC. AND STREETERVILLE CAPITAL, LLC Exhibit 10.1 THE EXCHANGE CONTEMPLATED HEREIN IS INTENDED TO COMPORT WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF SECTION 3(a)(9) OF THE SECURITIES ACT OF 1933, AS AMENDED. EXCHANGE AGREEMENT This Exchange Agreement (this “ Agreement ”) is entered into as of November 12, 2026 by and between Streeterville Capital, LLC, a Utah limited liability company (“ Lender ”), and Allarity Therapeutics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (“ Borrower ”). Certain capitalized terms are defined in Section 2 of this Agreement. A. Borrower previously sold and issued to Lender that certain Promissory Note A-1 dated March 2, 2026 in the original principal amount of $10,930,000.00 (the “ Note ”) pursuant to that certain Notes Purchase Agreement dated March 2, 2026 between Lender and Borrower (the “ Purchase Agreement ,” and together with the Note and all other documents entered into in conjunction therewith, the “ Transaction Documents ”). B. Subject to the terms of this Agreement, Borrower and Lender desire to partition a new Promissory Note A-1 in the form of the Note (the “ Partitioned Note ”) in the original principal amount of $3,000,000.00 (the “ Exchange Amount ”) from the Note and then cause the outstanding balance of the Note to be reduced by an amount equal to the Exchange Amount, and such outstanding principal balance shall therefore be $7,930,000. C. Borrower and Lender desire to exchange (such exchange is referred to as the “ Exchange ”) the Partitioned Note for 3,000 shares of Series B Preferred Stock (the “ Exchange Shares ”), according to the terms and conditions of this Agreement. D. Other than the surrender of the Partitioned Note, no consideration of any kind whatsoever shall be given by Lender to Borrower in connection with this Agreement. E. Lender and Borrower now desire to exchange the Partitioned Note for the Exchange Shares on the terms and conditions set forth herein. NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties agree as follows: 1. Recitals . Each of the parties hereto acknowledges and agrees that the recitals set forth above in this Agreement are true and accurate, are contractual in nature, and are hereby incorporated into and made a part of this Agreement. 2. Definitions . In addition to the terms defined elsewhere in this Agreement, the following terms, as used herein, have the following meanings: (a) “ Affiliate ” means, with respect to a specified Person, any other Person that directly or indirectly Controls, is Controlled by or is under common Control with, the specified Person. (b) “ Certificate of Designation ” means the Certificate of Designation of Preferences and Rights of Series B Preferred Stock to be filed with the Delaware Secretary of State. (c) “ Control ” means (a) the possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to vote 10% or more of the securities or other equity interests of a Person having ordinary voting power, (b) the possession, directly or indirectly, of the power to direct or cause the direction of the management and policies of a Person, by contract or otherwise, or (c) being a director, officer, executor, trustee or fiduciary (or their equivalents) of a Person or a Person that controls such Person. (d) “ Exchange Documents ” means this Agreement, the Certificate of Designation and any other agreement, document, certificate or writing delivered or to be delivered in connection with this Agreement and any other document related to the Transactions related to the foregoing, including, without limitation, those delivered at the Closing. (e) “ Person ” means a natural person, a corporation, a limited liability company, a partnership, an association, a trust or any other entity or organization, including a government or political subdivision or any agency or instrumentality thereof. (f) “ Securities Act ” means the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and the rules and regulations thereunder. (g) “ Series B Preferred Stock ” means shares of Borrower’s Series B Preferred Stock, par value $0.0001. (h) “ Transactions ” means the issuance the Exchange Shares and the other transactions contemplated in connection with the Exchange. 3. Closing . The closing of the Transactions (the “ Closing ”) shall occur following the execution of this Agreement and the effectiveness of the filing of the Series B Certificate, by means of the exchange of electronic signatures, but shall be deemed to have occurred at the offices of Capital Law Partners PLLC in Lehi, Utah. (a) Partition . Effective upon the acceptance of the Certificate of Designation by the Delaware Secretary of State, Borrower and Lender agree that the Partitioned Note will be partitioned from the Note. The Partitioned Note shall have terms identical to the Note, shall be evidenced by this Agreement without the need for Borrower to issue any separate instrument, and shall not be transferred, assigned, pledged or encumbered by Lender. Following such partition, Borrower and Lender agree that the security interests, guaranties and collateral agreements with respect to Note shall remain in full force and effect, provided that the outstanding balance of the Note shall be reduced by an amount equal to the Exchange Amount. (b) Exchange . Pursuant to the terms and conditions of this Agreement, at the Closing, Lender shall surrender the Partitioned Note to Borrower, and the Partitioned Note shall be cancelled and terminated and all obligations of Borrower under the Partitioned Note shall be deemed fulfilled, and the Partitioned Note shall thereafter be deemed terminated and null and void and of no further force or effect. The Exchange Shares are being issued in substitution of and exchange for and not in satisfaction of the Partitioned Note. Notwithstanding the foregoing, this Agreement will be terminated and deemed void ab initio if the Exchange Shares are not issued by November 16, 2026. 2 (c) Exemption . The partition of the Partitioned Note and the issuance of the Exchange Shares in exchange therefor are being made in reliance on the exemption from registration provided by Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act. 4. Borrower’s Representations, Warranties and Agreements . In order to induce Lender to enter into this Agreement, Borrower, for itself, and for its Affiliates, successors and assigns, hereby acknowledges, represents, warrants and agrees as follows: (a) Borrower has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement and to incur and perform all obligations and covenants contained herein, all of which have been duly authorized by all proper and necessary action, (b) no consent, approval, filing or registration with or notice to any governmental authority is required as a condition to the validity of this Agreement or the performance of any of the obligations of Borrower hereunder, (c) no event of default has occurred under the Note and any events of default that may have occurred thereunder have not been, and are not hereby, waived by Lender, (d) except as specifically set forth herein, nothing herein shall in any manner release, lessen, modify or otherwise affect Borrower’s obligations under the Note, (e) the issuance of the Exchange Shares is duly authorized by all necessary corporate action and the Exchange Shares will be validly issued, fully paid and non-assessable, free and clear of all taxes, liens, claims, pledges, mortgages, restrictions, obligations, security interests and encumbrances of any kind, nature and description, (f) Borrower has not received any consideration in any form whatsoever for entering into this Agreement, other than the surrender of the Partitioned Note, (g) Borrower has taken no action which would give rise to any claim by any person for a brokerage commission, placement agent or finder’s fee or other similar payment by Borrower related to this Agreement, and (h) no commission or other remuneration has been or will be paid or given, directly or indirectly, for soliciting the Exchange. 5. Lender’s Representations, Warranties and Agreements . In order to induce Borrower to enter into this Agreement, Lender, for itself, and for its Affiliates, successors and assigns, hereby acknowledges, represents, warrants and agrees as follows: (a) Lender has full power and authority to enter into this Agreement and to incur and perform all obligations and covenants contained herein, all of which have been duly authorized by all proper and necessary action, (b) no consent, approval, filing or registration with or notice to any governmental authority is required as a condition to the validity of this Agreement or the performance of any of the obligations of Lender hereunder, (c) Lender has taken no action which would give rise to any claim by any person for a brokerage commission, placement agent or finder’s fee or other similar payment by Borrower related to this Agreement, and (d) Lender is an “accredited investor” as defined in Rule 501 of Regulation D promulgated pursuant to the Securities Act. 6. Holding Period; Removal of Legends . Borrower acknowledges and agrees that, for purposes of Rule 144(d)(3)(ii) under the Securities Act, the holding period of the Exchange Shares commenced on March 2, 2026. Borrower shall not take any position inconsistent with the foregoing and, upon Lender’s request, shall cause its counsel to deliver, at Borrower’s expense, such legal opinions and instructions to its transfer agent as are necessary to remove restrictive legends from such shares. 3 7. Governing Law; Venue . This Agreement shall be construed and enforced in accordance with, and all questions concerning the construction, validity, interpretation and performance of this Agreement shall be governed by, the internal laws of the State of Utah, without giving effect to any choice of law or conflict of law provision or rule (whether of the State of Utah or any other jurisdictions) that would cause the application of the laws of any jurisdictions other than the State of Utah. The provisions set forth in the Purchase Agreement to determine the proper venue for any disputes are incorporated herein by this reference. EACH PARTY HERETO HEREBY IRREVOCABLY WAIVES ANY RIGHT IT MAY HAVE TO, AND AGREES NOT TO REQUEST, A JURY TRIAL FOR THE ADJUDICATION OF ANY DISPUTE HEREUNDER OR IN CONNECTION WITH OR ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR ANY TRANSACTIONS CONTEMPLATED HEREBY. 8. Arbitration of Claims . Any disputes arising under or in connection with the Exchange Documents or the Transactions, shall be subject to the Arbitration Provisions (as defined in the Purchase Agreement) attached as an exhibit to the Purchase Agreement. 9. Counterparts . This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original, but all of which together shall constitute one and the same instrument. Counterparts may be delivered via electronic signature (including pdf or any electronic signature complying with the U.S. federal ESIGN Act of 2000, e.g., www.docusign.com) and any counterpart so delivered shall be deemed to have been duly and validly delivered and be valid and effective for all purposes. 10. Attorneys’ Fees . In the event of any action at law or in equity to enforce or interpret the terms of the Exchange Documents, the parties agree that the prevailing party be entitled to an additional award of the full amount of the attorneys’ fees and expenses paid by such prevailing party in connection with the litigation and/or dispute without reduction or apportionment based upon the individual claims or defenses giving rise to the fees and expenses. Nothing herein shall restrict or impair a court’s power to award fees and expenses for frivolous or bad faith pleading. 11. No Reliance . Borrower acknowledges and agrees that neither Lender nor any of its officers, directors, members, managers, equity holders, representatives or agents has made any representations or warranties to Borrower or any of its agents, representatives, officers, directors, or employees except as expressly set forth in this Agreement and the Exchange Documents and, in making its decision to enter into the transactions contemplated by this Agreement, Borrower is not relying on any representation, warranty, covenant or promise of Lender or its officers, directors, members, managers, equity holders, agents or representatives other than as set forth in this Agreement. 12. Severability . If any part of this Agreement is construed to be in violation of any law, such part shall be modified to achieve the objective of the parties to the fullest extent permitted and the balance of this Agreement shall remain in full force and effect. 13. Entire Agreement . This Agreement, together with the Transaction Documents and the Exchange Documents, and all other documents referred to herein, supersedes all other prior oral or written agreements between Borrower, Lender, its Affiliates and persons acting on its behalf with respect to the matters discussed herein, other than the Exchange Documents and the Transaction Documents, which remain in full force and effect as modified hereby, and this Agreement and the instruments referenced herein contain the entire understanding of the parties with respect to the matters covered herein and therein and, except as specifically set forth herein or therein, neither Lender nor Borrower makes any representation, warranty, covenant or undertaking with respect to such matters. 4 14. Amendments . This Agreement may be amended, modified, or supplemented only by written agreement of the parties. No provision of this Agreement may be waived except in writing signed by the party against whom such waiver is sought to be enforced. 15. Successors and Assigns . This Agreement shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the parties and their respective successors and assigns. This Agreement or any of the severable rights and obligations inuring to the benefit of or to be performed by Lender hereunder may be assigned by Lender to a third party, including its financing sources, in whole or in part. Borrower may not assign this Agreement or any of its obligations herein without the prior written consent of Lender. 16. Continuing Enforceability; Conflict Between Documents . Except as otherwise modified by this Agreement, the Transaction Documents shall remain in full force and effect, enforceable in accordance with all of their original terms and provisions. This Agreement shall not be effective or binding unless and until it is fully executed and delivered by Lender and Borrower. If there is any conflict between the terms of this Agreement, on the one hand, and the Transaction Documents, on the other hand, the terms of this Agreement shall prevail. 17. Time of Essence . Time is of the essence with respect to each and every provision of this Agreement. 18. Notices . Unless otherwise specifically provided for herein, all notices, demands or requests required or permitted under this Agreement to be given to Borrower or Lender shall be given as set forth in the “Notices” section of the Purchase Agreement. 19. Further Assurances . Each party shall do and perform or cause to be done and performed, all such further acts and things, and shall execute and deliver all such other agreements, certificates, instruments and documents, as the other party may reasonably request in order to carry out the intent and accomplish the purposes of this Agreement and the consummation of the transactions contemplated hereby. [Remainder of page intentionally left blank] 5 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned have executed this Agreement as of the date first set forth above. BORROWER: ALLARITY THERAPEUTICS, INC. By: /s/ Thomas Jensen Thomas Jensen, CEO LENDER: STREETERVILLE CAPITAL, LLC By: /s/ John Fife John Fife, President
